_about: One release entry in the release format, written by scripts/release-runs.py from real runs of two builds. The commands, output lines, exit codes, result files, builds and footer come from the raw record in site/changelog/logs/; whole lines are cut to fit by the fixture, no line is edited. Only date, label, headline, lead, next.note and film are written by hand.
label: Report change
headline: stash now says whether the folder is clear

footer: Both outputs come from real runs of two builds: tag stash-v0.5.3 (commit 427582b) and tag stash-v0.5.4 (commit de8f307).
